title: Our protocol, read through your label
name: Elohim, Read Through DTPR — a letter to the DTPR community
description: A letter from the Elohim Protocol to Helpful Places and the DTPR (Digital Trust for Places and Routines) Community of Practice. It describes the protocol in DTPR's own visual language as three validated datachains, from the seat of a person running their own node, from a doorway's hosted first stage, and for solidarity pricing, and offers one piece of advice: don't label the AI; label the parties who arrive carrying it. Every claim carries a trust mark for what backs it and where it stands today.
